system_unit_decision.unit: the source-native Pohakuloa high-elevation dryland flower-visitation community
system_unit_decision.focal_plant_sheets_role: within-system sampling strata; they are not independent natural-regime systems
system_unit_decision.raw_site_field_role: free-text within-ecosystem location descriptor used only to distinguish scan events, not to manufacture stable site replicates
system_unit_decision.correction_of_provisional_screening_note: Earlier provisional screening treated the eight focal-plant sheets as eight candidate systems. That would violate the frozen primary_system_unit. The admitted count is one system.

source_native_adapter.time_bin: source Date, converted to ISO calendar date without merging or splitting
source_native_adapter.partner_id: Scan visitor spp with whitespace collapsed and uppercase normalization only; no synonym, taxonomy or morphology-based alias merging is performed before coordinates open
source_native_adapter.value: Scan # Inds summed over unique scan-event × partner records within date
source_native_adapter.effort: number of unique source-native scan events within date
source_native_adapter.zero_rule: dates are expanded to the union of observed raw partner labels; an unobserved partner in an observed date receives value 0 with that date's positive scan effort

unquantified_positive_scan_rows.rule: if Scan visitor spp is identifiable but Scan # Inds is missing, exclude that unquantified numerator record while retaining its scan event in the effort denominator; do not impute a count

structural_gate_evidence.sampling_effort_status: explicitly normalizable from source-native scan events

decision.reason: One source-native island interaction community passes the frozen temporal, partner-identity, quantitative-interaction and effort-normalization requirements.

claim_boundaries: Hawaii contributes one natural-regime system, not eight independent systems.
The eight focal-plant sheets remain sampling strata within one ecosystem.
Raw Site strings are not normalized into post-hoc independent sites.
No reproductive or performance outcome was used for admission.
No D1, phi, rho_eq or route-classification value was inspected to make this admission decision.
Natural breadth is not mapped literally onto synthetic k.
